notes.title: Fire and Fury: English Civil War Version 2.0.1 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Add: Map labels to most scenarios.
[*] Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
[*] Change: Improved game logic for advance after combat. Unit will more often advance after combat if the target hex has been vacated.
[*] Change: Mission design credits and sources.
[*] Change: Source material credits.
[*] Fix: An issue with image scaling on older Apple iOS devices.
[*] Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
[*] Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[*] Update: Campaign map graphics. It is now clearer which campaigns have been completed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fix: Improved memory management.
Fix: Improved hex tile Positioning accuracy.
Fix: Bug affecting some units melee abilities.
Add: A Change speed option in settings. This has three options standard, slow and fast which effects how fast the game plays.
Fix: Cheriton mission was ending with wrong side winning sometimes.

Any issues please contact : support@hexwar.com
